note: Base64-decoded OpenSSH key material is parsed into a project ssh_buffer and fed to the vulnerable unpack path.
The unpack routine snapshots the remaining buffer length before consuming fields.
The format parser trusts caller-supplied length for the 'P' field instead of proving that len is bounded by the remaining buffer bytes.
Validation happens after len is already read from the variadic arguments, so malformed calls can steer the subsequent read size.
The routine copies len bytes out of the buffer into a newly allocated destination, triggering invalid memory access when len exceeds available data or the allocation/length relationship is wrong.
